pdpf.label: PDPF
pdpf.description: Personal data retention, access controls, and breach escalation.

requirements.subject: customer_record_retention
requirements.text: Customer records must be retained for 5 years after the relationship ends.
requirements.new_text: Customer records must be retained for 7 years after the relationship ends.
requirements.change_summary: Customer Record Retention: 5 years to 7 years

requirements.subject: data_access_restriction
requirements.text: Access to personal data must be limited to authorised personnel.

requirements.subject: breach_notification
requirements.text: Material personal-data breaches must be escalated promptly.

merger-acquisition.label: Merger & Acquisition
merger-acquisition.description: Deal approvals, merger control, due diligence, and integration governance.

requirements.subject: transaction_notification_threshold
requirements.text: Transactions valued above SGD 50 million require pre-closing notification.
requirements.new_text: Transactions valued above SGD 25 million require pre-closing notification.
requirements.change_summary: Transaction notification threshold: SGD 50 million to SGD 25 million

requirements.subject: competition_due_diligence
requirements.text: Acquirers must complete competition due diligence before signing.

requirements.subject: integration_records
requirements.text: Integration decision records must be retained for 7 years.

capital-markets.label: Capital Markets
capital-markets.description: Issuer disclosures, offering controls, and material transaction reporting.

requirements.subject: material_transaction_reporting
requirements.text: Transactions above SGD 10 million must be disclosed to the market.
requirements.new_text: Transactions above SGD 5 million must be disclosed to the market.
requirements.change_summary: Market disclosure threshold: SGD 10 million to SGD 5 million

requirements.subject: prospectus_verification
requirements.text: Every prospectus statement must be supported by verification evidence.

requirements.subject: inside_information_control
requirements.text: Inside information must be restricted until public disclosure.

energy-market.label: Energy Market
energy-market.description: Generation reserves, dispatch operations, and market incident reporting.

requirements.subject: operating_reserve_margin
requirements.text: Licensed generators must maintain an operating reserve margin of 15 percent.
requirements.new_text: Licensed generators must maintain an operating reserve margin of 20 percent.
requirements.change_summary: Operating reserve margin: 15 percent to 20 percent

requirements.subject: dispatch_instruction
requirements.text: Dispatch instructions must be acknowledged and logged immediately.

requirements.subject: market_incident_notification
requirements.text: Material market incidents must be reported within 2 hours.

carbon-credit.label: Carbon Credit
carbon-credit.description: Credit retirement, project verification, and registry reconciliation.

requirements.subject: credit_retirement_deadline
requirements.text: Credits used for a claim must be retired within 12 months of the claim date.
requirements.new_text: Credits used for a claim must be retired within 6 months of the claim date.
requirements.change_summary: Credit retirement deadline: 12 months to 6 months

requirements.subject: project_verification
requirements.text: Every credited project must pass independent verification.

requirements.subject: registry_reconciliation
requirements.text: Registry holdings must be reconciled monthly.
